kit.name: SunFounder Basic Starter Kit for Raspberry Pi

items.name: ADS7830 Module
items.notes: LAFVIN-branded I2C ADC board; a different chip from the ADS1115 in the part library

items.name: 20mm Dot Matrix Module
items.notes: bare 8x8 matrix marked 788BS; the project text says common anode

items.name: Relay Module
items.notes: relay board with screw terminals and an indicator LED, not a bare relay; the project page photo shows SRD-05VDC-SL-C

items.name: Motor & Fan
items.notes: motor with a fan blade

items.name: Slide Switch
items.notes: no project page in the docs uses it

items.name: LED-RGB
items.notes: common cathode is inferred, not stated: the 1.1.2 wiring diagram ties the longest (common) leg to GND and the code drives the colour pins high to light them

items.name: LED-Red
items.notes: label reads "LED-Red/Yellow/Green White/ Blue x5" and the photo shows one LED of each of the five colours; the count per colour and the LED diameter are not stated

items.name: LED-Yellow
items.notes: see LED-Red: count per colour and diameter not stated

items.name: LED-Green
items.notes: see LED-Red: count per colour and diameter not stated

items.name: LED-White
items.notes: see LED-Red: count per colour and diameter not stated

items.name: LED-Blue
items.notes: see LED-Red: count per colour and diameter not stated

items.name: Thermistor
items.notes: shares a tile with the tilt switch; the 2.2.2 page says NTC, 10kΩ at 25°C, B = 3950

items.name: Tilt Switch
items.notes: shares a tile with the thermistor; the photo shows SW-520D

items.name: Capacitor 104
items.notes: no project page in the docs uses it

items.name: F-M DuPont Cable
items.notes: length not stated

items.name: F-F DuPont Cable
items.notes: length not stated

items.name: 1N4007
items.notes: no project page in the docs uses it

items.name: PN2222
items.notes: NPN transistor in a TO-92 body; the buzzer pages show a PN2222A. The kit has no S8050 or S8550

items.name: 1 Dight 7-segment Display
items.notes: printed with the spelling Dight; the photo shows CL5611AH and the 1.1.4 page says common cathode (a code comment on that page says common anode, but its segment codes are active high)

items.name: DHT11 Temperature and Humidity Module
items.notes: 3-pin module on a small board

items.name: 65 Jumper Wire
items.notes: the photo shows pre-formed jumper wires with a pin at each end in assorted lengths; the text pages call them some jumper wires

items.name: Button
items.notes: the 2.1.1 page says 6 mm tactile button

source.note: User's kit; listing photo docs/v2/3D Reference Images/T-Cobbler and BreadBoard/Ribbon and BreadBoard.jpg

items.name: 830-point breadboard
items.notes: the listing says 400-hole; the photos show a full-size 830-point board

leads.note: SPEC 7: no lead counts are enforced unless the user sets them
